ios.desc:
What is that? Point your camera and find out in seconds.

SnapID identifies anything you can photograph — a rock on a hiking trail, a coin in a drawer, a bug on the wall, a plant in a friend's window, a building you walked past — and gives you a clear name plus a detailed description covering material, color, shape and key features.

One app instead of seven. Most identifier apps do one thing: rocks, or birds, or plants. SnapID handles whatever you point it at.

WHAT YOU CAN IDENTIFY

• Rocks, minerals, crystals, gemstones and fossils
• Coins, stamps and collectibles
• Bugs, insects and spiders
• Plants, flowers, trees, leaves and mushrooms
• Birds and animals, including dog breeds
• Landmarks, buildings and monuments
• Products, gadgets, tools and everyday household objects

HOW IT WORKS

1. Open SnapID and point your camera at whatever caught your eye
2. Frame the subject so the AI knows exactly what to look at
3. Get an instant identification with a full description
4. Every scan saves to your history automatically, so you can revisit it later

WHY PEOPLE USE SNAPID

• Rich descriptions, not just a one-word label
• Works on anything you can point a camera at, indoors or outdoors
• Your whole scan history in one place
• Fast enough to use while you are still standing there

PREMIUM

SnapID Premium removes the daily scan limit and unlocks full AI descriptions for every scan. Choose the plan that suits you — weekly or annual.

• Unlimited scans every day
• Full AI-powered descriptions and details
• No daily limits interrupting you

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS

SnapID offers auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your device's subscription settings.
